feeds.title: Eater Atlanta
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest food news and dining guides for Atlanta. Eater's coverage ranges from extensive city maps and travel dining guides marking all the best places to eat, punchy editorials exploring the cultural significance of what and how people eat, in-depth industry investigations, and light-hearted ruminations on food fads and cooking tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Lana's Cooking
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Lana Stuart, the cook and author behind Lana's Cooking. I live in Georgia, in the southern U.S., with my very patient, taste-tester, and my husband Bill. I started Lana's Cooking in 2009 as a fun way to record some of the old, classic southern comfort food recipes that I grew up cooking with my mother, grandmothers, and aunts.

feeds.title: Savory Spin Blog
feeds.description: Hiya, I'm Shashi, the blogger behind Savory Spin. Here you can browse a collection of super easy, economical, mostly fusion recipes that can be made with ingredients from your local grocery store. Find hundreds of deliciously spiced, fusion recipes you can easily make at home. From breakfast to lunch to dinner to your next holiday celebration find the perfect dish to satisfy even the most demanding craving, just by adding some spice!

feeds.title: Life Love and Sugar
feeds.description: Easy and delicious dessert recipes you'll love. From no-bake cheesecakes and fluffy cakes to the best cookies and cupcakes!

feeds.title: He & She Eat Clean
feeds.description: A wellness blog with recipes, workouts, and tips about living a healthy lifestyle. We're Scott & Whitney. Together we changed our life through clean eating and weight training and now we share our healthy recipes, workouts, and tips and tricks with you! We also take you on our adventures from hiking and backpacking to skiing.

feeds.title: Savvy Mama Lifestyle » Recipes
feeds.description: Welcome to Savvy Mama Lifestyle - a resource for family travel tips, Millennial parenting, entertainment, recipes, & reviews. We love featuring fun travel destinations, great food and things to do as a family.

feeds.title: Savvy Mama Lifestyle » Recipes
feeds.description: This blog is a combination of my passions for Family Fun, Travel, Entertainment, Parenting and Food. I strive to make this a great resource for Millennial Moms.

feeds.title: The Vgn Way
feeds.description: Hundred's of easy, affordable & delicious gluten-free vegan recipes. The Vgn Way offers great and healthy recipes for a plant-based diet.

feeds.title: Marilyn Wolf's Food and Restaurant Blog
feeds.description: Marilyn Wolf thoughts on the Atlanta food scene, with occasional forays into the world beyond. Find restaurant reviews and recipes.

feeds.title: Add a Pinch
feeds.description: Browse 1500+ simple, tested, and perfected recipes the whole family will love! Featuring family-friendly quick and easy meals, desserts, and more!

feeds.title: Marisa Moore Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Marisa, a registered dietitian nutritionist living in Atlanta, GA. I use this blog to share (mostly) vegetarian recipes, credible nutrition information and a peek into my Southern roots and travels!

feeds.title: Keto Connect
feeds.description: A keto blog committed to publishing helpful resources, developing delicious recipes, and offering advice to people striving to live healthier lives. Matt and Megha have discovered their life's purpose which is being deeply passionate about cooking and nutrition.

feeds.title: The Sophisticated Caveman Blog
feeds.description: I'm Brian aka The Sophisticated Caveman. Here you'll find healthy Paleo, Keto, and gluten-free recipes, natural living tips, and outdoor adventures. Whether you're looking to lose weight, get outside, or just eat some tasty food, I'm glad you're here!

feeds.title: Mi Diario de Cocina
feeds.description: Easy and delicious cooking recipes with step-by-step photos. A variety of recipes from Chilean cuisine, international, bakery (cakes, pies, kuchen, desserts), vegetarian, and much more.

feeds.title: Life Bistro Blog
feeds.description: Find out why everyone is raving about the best new vegan restaurant in Atlanta. If you love Slutty Vegan or Soul Vegetarian then you will love Life Bistro! At Life Bistro, we are committed to serving food that promotes life in its many forms. Our dishes highlight cuisine from around the world while featuring classic American comfort food, veganized.

feeds.title: Souper Jenny Atlanta
feeds.description: Souper Jenny is a collection of five, cozy neighborhood cafes serving the Atlanta community fresh and delicious food since 1999. Jenny Levison, our founder and chief 'soup slinger,' still works daily creating new and exciting recipes for a loyal clientele.

feeds.title: Roamilicious » Recipes
feeds.description: Welcome to Roamilicious, a food, travel and lifestyle Blog. I'm Malika Bowling, a foodie and traveler married with no kids. Love traveling & finding the next great foodie spot with my husband / photographer, Glen.

feeds.title: Simply Sabrina » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Simply Sabrina is a petite fashion and lifestyle blog based in Atlanta Georgia. Simply Sabrina shares personal style looks, beauty tricks, recipes, and interior design.

feeds.title: Atlanta Mom » Food
feeds.description: Atlanta Mom is building a community online and offline to connect moms from around Atlanta. We continue our passion for bringing the women of the Atlanta Area together in a supportive online community, encouraging you in your parenting journey.

feeds.title: Dash of Herbs Blog
feeds.description: A food blog dedicated to easy, healthy recipes from scratch in about 30 minutes. All recipes include Weight Watchers Points.

feeds.title: The Sensible Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Tabatha James is a wife, mom, and children's book author navigating her way through a vegan way of life! Find vegan news, reviews, and recipes! A wife, mom, an Atlanta vegan blogger, activist, vegan children's book author, and the founder of The Sensible Vegan. I became vegan overnight in 2016 after watching Vegucated and never looked back.

feeds.title: The Front Porch Gourmet
feeds.description: The Front Porch Gourmet was created to blend family recipes, fantastic restaurants, travel, and innovative products with a little Southern humor.

feeds.title: ChefNat
feeds.description: At ChefNat, Your #1 destination for delicious recipes and a look into my honest food experiences. Based out of Atlanta, GA. Hi! Thank you for stopping by. My name is Natalie and I have always been passionate about food. I am lucky enough to have tried a variety, which ignited my love for cooking.

feeds.title: Eating With Erica Blog
feeds.description: Eating With Erica highlights delicious recipes, incredible travel destinations, and entertaining inspo. Erica is an Atlanta-based blogger with a passion for all things dining, entertaining, and food.

feeds.title: Healthy Eating 101
feeds.description: Atlanta's Edible Garden Chef featuring fresh healthy lifestyle recipes and culinary deliciousness to tantalize and delight you!

feeds.title: VegOut Magazine » Vegan Atlanta Guide
feeds.description: Explore VegOut Magazine's vegan Atlanta guide with top food and restaurant picks, and more! You'll be surprised what the peach state's capital has to offer. VegOut - a group of vegans passionate about the plant-based food and lifestyle scene, living in cities across the US. We work to bring you the best vegan content around.

feeds.title: mydietitian Blog
feeds.description: Weight loss that doesn't suck starts with a total metabolism makeover. A vodka-loving dietitian with a no-bs approach to healthy eating. Nutrition coach + author of the nutrition addiction. Designer protein ambassador.

feeds.title: Fat Sisters Blog
feeds.description: Fat Sisters Flavortime Blog is bursting open the food scene in Atlanta and beyond. Discover new recipes, menu ideas, and other flavorful food excursions. Fat Sisters Atlanta is about Flavor and Food. From our mealprep to our specialty food products we got you covered. Also, we can handle your catering needs.
